lines.text: The speaker's heart is faint, and the people cry from far away asking whether the LORD is still in Zion.
The speaker asks whether there is no balm in Bethel and no physician there.
The speaker wishes for a fountain of tears, and for a traveler's lodge in the wilderness to leave his people.
The LORD of Hosts says He will crush them and test them.
The LORD will make Jerusalem a heap of rubble and the cities of Judah a desolation without inhabitant.
